source.provider: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public (COP-DEM_GLO-30-DGED), AWS Open Data COG release
source.type: DSM (surface model: includes buildings, trees and infrastructure)
source.native_resolution: 1 arc-second (about 30.9 m N-S, 23-26 m E-W at 32-42 deg N)
source.vertical_datum: EGM2008 (not converted; the LiDAR arrays are REDNAP / NAVD88: compare slopes and relative elevations, or de-biased differences)

split_guard: urbanmorph.data.m12_index.load_index_m12(include_test=False); splits restricted to ['train', 'val', 'val_t'] before any request; refused when M12_INCLUDE_TEST=yes; the test splits ['test', 'test_t'] were never read, built or fetched
selection: development tiles of spain / united_states whose data/processed/m12/terrain/<sid>.npz has valid.any() (LiDAR terrain today)

processing.mosaic: rasterio.merge of the 1-degree cells, bounds snapped to source pixel edges
processing.grid: tile UTM CRS, 4 m, tile + 256 m margin, 256 x 256, row 0 = north, from_origin(xmin - 256, ymax + 256, 4, 4) (= terrain.data.tile_terrain)
processing.note: a 30 m DSM sampled at 4 m; never describe it as 4 m terrain

norm.note: GLO-30 training tiles with a full DEM only (473); recipe of scripts/m12_prepare_data.py (elev_scale = std of elevation differences within 96 m, slope_scale = median over tiles of the tile p90 slope), same seed and tile order. LiDAR (M12 TN) values: elev_scale 6.8092, slope_scale 0.1289

norm_lidar_m12.note: training tiles with a DEM only; elev_scale = std of elevation differences within 96 m, slope_scale = median over tiles of the tile p90 slope
